note: Adapted from the description of Roonwal and Chhotani (1965) as transcribed by Chhotani (1997); the original is in English; soldier and worker known, alate unknown; the original gives the greatest width of the worker head capsule as “Q.77-0.90”, whose first digit is lost to OCR, so only the upper limit was recorded and this measurement was not entered (as in the original); literature citations, figure numbers and distributions omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head capsule subrectangular, longer than wide, sides nearly parallel; mandibles thick and short, base very broad, ratio of basal width to mandible length 0.67–0.71; left mandible with a prominent large tooth situated above the middle, with 1–3 small denticles near the base in addition, right mandible with teeth in a similar position; postmentum rod-shaped, waist broad and long, anterior margin straight, posterior margin incurved; pronotum wider than long, anterior lobe strongly upturned. Alate not described.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule straw yellow; antennae, postclypeus, thorax and legs much paler than the head; mandibles dark brown, base yellowish brown; labrum transparent; abdomen white. Head and body densely hairy. Body length about 4.30–5.30 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, longer than wide; head length to mandibular base 1.47–1.60 mm, greatest width 1.07–1.20 mm; sides nearly parallel, posterior margin slightly rounded. Fontanelle indistinct. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 subequal in length to segment 2, segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus large, subtrapezoidal, hairy; anteclypeus thin, hairless, band-like. Labrum broadly ligulate, anterior margin broad, truncate and slightly incurved. Mandibles thick and short, base very broad; length 0.67–0.70 mm, basal width of left mandible 0.47–0.50 mm, ratio of basal width to mandible length 0.67–0.71. Left mandible with a prominent large tooth situated above the middle, with 1–3 small denticles near the base in addition; right mandible with a tooth in a similar position and 1 small denticle near the base in addition; ratio of distance from tooth to apex to mandible length in the left mandible 0.39–0.40. Postmentum rod-shaped, waist broad and long; length 0.83–0.97 mm, greatest width 0.30–0.35 mm, waist width 0.20–0.23 mm; anterior margin straight, posterior margin incurved. Pronotum saddle-shaped, wider than long; length 0.33–0.36 mm, width 0.60–0.67 mm; anterior lobe strongly upturned, anterior margin without a notch. Fore legs stouter, hind legs longest.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule and postclypeus pale straw yellow; antennae, legs and thorax much paler; abdomen darkened by intestinal contents showing through. Head and body rather hairy. Body length about 3.50–4.10 mm. Head capsule subcircular, wider than long; head length to mandibular base 0.67–0.75 mm; sides slightly narrowed posteriorly, posterior margin rounded. Fontanelle indistinct. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 slightly shorter than segment 2, segment 4 shortest. Anteclypeus hairless, subtrapezoidal, middle projecting forward; postclypeus convex, hairy, length slightly more than half its width; length 0.23 mm, width 0.37 mm. Labrum broadly ligulate, wider than long; length 0.27–0.30 mm, width 0.37–0.40 mm. Pronotum saddle-shaped, length 0.23–0.28 mm, width 0.50–0.58 mm.
